title: Kumpel und Hütte homepage: pick the composition
question: Three compositions of the kitchen-table world. Pick the one to build. One honesty note: the comps warm up your real kitchen photo and add a lamp, candle and table that are not in it. By default I will build from your real photo (upscaled, warm-graded) without invented objects, unless you say otherwise in the steer box.

options.label: Photo is the room
options.thesis: Full-bleed kitchen, headline on a linen place-card lower left.
options.viewport: Photo fills the viewport; header over it; linen card with headline and call button.
options.risk: Text over photo needs a scrim; the photo must carry the whole page.

options.label: Split with fridge note
options.thesis: Headline column left, photo right, the 970 € note pinned across both, two doors below.
options.viewport: Big headline left, photo right, price note overlapping, 'Für Sie / Für Angehörige' doors peeking.
options.risk: Most content in the first viewport; the note must stay calm.

options.label: Open door into the kitchen
options.thesis: Centered headline and actions, then a wide panoramic kitchen like looking through a doorway.
options.viewport: Moss contact strip, centered headline, two buttons, kitchen panorama below.
options.risk: Symmetry can feel formal; the photo sits lower on mobile.
